resources.name: Saleor — Multi-dimensional pricing (3.24)
resources.description: Scoped variant prices and customer conditions on promotion rules. Fill url, username, password and channel in the Base Environment, then run folder 00 once. Every id a request produces is written to the environment by its after-response script, so run the folders top to bottom. Each request logs in as username/password in its pre-request step and uses that token unless its name says 'as customer' or 'as guest'. Folder 04 waits on the Celery beat worker. Run folder 99 to remove the test data.

resources.name: 00 · Setup
resources.description: Run once, top to bottom. Creates the B2B test customer type, a Loyalty level dropdown attribute (Silver, Gold), a plain text attribute for the invalid case, a customer in scope (B2B + Gold) with a password and a customer token, a customer of the default type, and picks the first in-stock variant of the channel. Requires MANAGE_CUSTOMER_TYPES_AND_ATTRIBUTES, MANAGE_USERS and MANAGE_PRODUCTS on the staff account.

resources.name: channel — by slug → channelId
resources.description: Sets channelId.

resources.name: productVariants — first in-stock variant of the channel → variantId, listingId, prices
resources.description: Sets variantId, productId, listingId (the listing of the environment channel), listingPrice, scopedPrice (80% of the listing price) and windowPrice (90%). Pick a variant without scoped prices: `prices` should be empty.

resources.name: customerTypeCreate — B2B test → customerTypeId
resources.description: Sets customerTypeId.

resources.name: attributeCreate — Loyalty level test (DROPDOWN: Silver, Gold) → attributeId, value ids
resources.description: Sets attributeId, silverValueId and goldValueId.

resources.name: attributeCreate — Notes test (PLAIN_TEXT) → textAttributeId
resources.description: A customer attribute without a fixed set of choices. Its values cannot scope a price. Sets textAttributeId.

resources.name: attributeValueCreate — a value of the plain text attribute → textValueId
resources.description: Used by the INVALID cases in folders 03 and 05. Sets textValueId.

resources.name: customerTypeAssignAttributes — both attributes to B2B test
accountRegister — the in-scope customer, as guest
resources.description: Registers customerEmail with customerPassword so a customer token can be created. redirectUrl is only needed when the shop requires email confirmation. The next request activates and confirms the account regardless.

resources.name: user — by email → customerId
resources.description: accountRegister does not return the id. Sets customerId.

resources.name: customerUpdate — activate, confirm, B2B test type, Gold value
resources.description: The customer is now in scope of both a B2B test type condition and a Gold value condition.

resources.name: tokenCreate — as the customer → customerToken
resources.description: Sets customerToken, sent by every request named 'as customer'.

resources.name: customerCreate — a customer of the default type → otherCustomerId
resources.description: Outside every scope used by the collection. Sets otherCustomerId.

resources.name: 01 · Scoped price by type and by value
resources.description: Creates a price scoped to the B2B test type, reads it from four perspectives, moves the scope to the Gold value, moves the customer off and back onto the value, then deletes the price.

resources.name: variantChannelListingPriceCreate — scoped to B2B test → priceId
resources.description: Sets priceId. The price is scopedPrice, 80% of the listing price.

resources.name: productVariant — channelListings.prices (staff)
resources.description: Expect one scoped price on the listing of the environment channel. `price` of the listing is unchanged.

resources.name: productVariant.pricing — as customer (expect scopedPrice)
resources.description: priceUndiscounted.gross.amount should be scopedPrice.

resources.name: productVariant.pricing — as guest (expect listingPrice)
resources.description: A guest never matches a customer type condition.

resources.name: productVariant.pricing(customer:) — staff preview of the customer (expect scopedPrice)
resources.description: Needs MANAGE_PRODUCTS and MANAGE_USERS.

resources.name: productVariant.pricing(customer:) — staff preview of the other customer (expect listingPrice)
resources.description: The default type customer is out of scope.

resources.name: variantChannelListingPriceUpdate — replace the type condition with the Gold value
resources.description: customerTypes becomes empty, customerAttributes shows the Loyalty level test attribute with Gold.

resources.name: productVariant.pricing — as customer, matched by value (expect scopedPrice)
customerUpdate — move the customer to Silver
productVariant.pricing — as customer on Silver (expect listingPrice)
resources.description: The price is resolved on every request, so the change is visible right away.

resources.name: customerUpdate — move the customer back to Gold
variantChannelListingPriceDelete
resources.description: Run 'as guest' and 'as customer' pricing again if you want to see both back on listingPrice.

resources.name: 02 · Checkout and draft order
resources.description: Recreates a type-scoped price, then checks checkout lines as the customer, detaches and reattaches the customer as staff, creates a draft order for the customer and switches it to the other customer. Cleans up its price at the end.

resources.name: variantChannelListingPriceCreate — scoped to B2B test, for the checkout → priceId
checkoutCreate — as customer → checkoutId (expect undiscountedUnitPrice = scopedPrice)
resources.description: Sets checkoutId. The line is priced for the checkout customer.

resources.name: checkoutCustomerDetach — staff (expect lines back to listingPrice)
resources.description: Detaching invalidates the checkout prices, so the returned lines are already recalculated.

resources.name: checkoutCustomerAttach — staff, the in-scope customer (expect scopedPrice again)
resources.description: Needs IMPERSONATE_USER when attaching someone else.

resources.name: checkout — as customer
draftOrderCreate — staff, for the customer → draftOrderId (expect scopedPrice)
resources.description: Sets draftOrderId. undiscountedUnitPrice.gross.amount should be scopedPrice.

resources.name: draftOrderUpdate — switch to the other customer (expect listingPrice)
resources.description: Changing the customer expires the draft line prices, so the response already shows undiscountedUnitPrice and unitPrice at listingPrice for the default type customer.

resources.name: order — the draft order
draftOrderDelete
variantChannelListingPriceDelete — cleanup
resources.description: The checkout is left to expire.

resources.name: 03 · Promotions with customer conditions
resources.description: A catalogue rule scoped to the B2B test type, checked as the customer and as a guest, moved to the Gold value, then an order rule that relies on its customer condition alone. Rules are added with promotionRuleCreate, which materializes the rule variants right away. Rules nested in promotionCreate only get materialized by the Celery beat task, so they would not apply on a store without a worker. Deletes both promotions at the end.

resources.name: promotionCreate — CATALOGUE, no rules → cataloguePromotionId
resources.description: Sets cataloguePromotionId.

resources.name: promotionRuleCreate — 10% on the variant, scoped to B2B test → catalogueRuleId
resources.description: Sets catalogueRuleId. The rule variants are materialized synchronously, so the next request sees the discount.

resources.name: productVariant.pricing — as customer (expect onSale, 10% discount)
resources.description: price.gross.amount should be 90% of priceUndiscounted.

resources.name: productVariant.pricing — as guest (expect no discount)
resources.description: A catalogue rule with customer conditions is left out of the stored discounted price.

resources.name: promotionRuleUpdate — replace the type condition with the Gold value
resources.description: Run the 'as customer' pricing again: still discounted, matched by value now.

resources.name: promotionRuleUpdate — plain text value (expect INVALID with customerAttributeValues)
resources.description: The error lists the rejected value id in customerAttributeValues and the rule keeps its Gold condition.

resources.name: promotionCreate — ORDER, no rules → orderPromotionId
resources.description: Sets orderPromotionId.

resources.name: promotionRuleCreate — 5% subtotal with the Gold condition only → orderRuleId
resources.description: An order rule may have an empty orderPredicate when it has customer conditions. Sets orderRuleId.

resources.name: checkoutCreate — as customer (expect discount = 5% of the subtotal)
resources.description: discount.amount should be 5% of the undiscounted subtotal, discountName names the promotion. Lines also carry the 10% catalogue rule from above.

resources.name: checkout — as customer, after the discounts are stored (expect discount = 5%)
resources.description: The order promotion discount shows in discount and discountName once stored. Lines carry the 10% catalogue rule in unitPrice.

resources.name: checkoutCreate — as guest (expect no discount)
resources.description: A guest never matches, so discount is null and the lines are undiscounted.

resources.name: promotionRuleCreate — empty orderPredicate and no condition (expect REQUIRED)
resources.description: Expect one REQUIRED error on orderPredicate.

resources.name: promotionRuleUpdate — clear the only condition of the order rule (expect REQUIRED)
resources.description: A rule with neither a predicate nor conditions is refused, the Gold condition stays.

resources.name: promotionDelete — the catalogue promotion
promotionDelete — the order promotion
04 · Validity window (waits on the beat worker)
resources.description: A window-only price applies to everyone, guests included, and is folded into the stored discounted price by the background recalculation. Wait about a minute between the create or delete and the guest check. Needs Celery beat and a worker running.

resources.name: productVariant.pricing — as guest, before (expect listingPrice)
variantChannelListingPriceCreate — window only, open now until 2030 → windowPriceId
resources.description: No customer condition, so the window is the only condition. Sets windowPriceId. The product is marked for recalculation right away.

resources.name: productVariant.pricing — as guest, after about a minute (expect windowPrice)
resources.description: priceUndiscounted and price both show windowPrice once the recalculation ran. Retry until it does.

resources.name: variantChannelListingPriceDelete — the window price
productVariant.pricing — as guest, after about a minute (expect listingPrice)
05 · Delete guards and validation
resources.description: A price scoped to both the type and the Gold value makes every delete guard fire, then the validation errors of the price mutations and the preview permission. Deletes its price at the end.

resources.name: variantChannelListingPriceCreate — scoped to B2B test and Gold → priceId
customerTypeDelete (expect CANNOT_DELETE)
resources.description: The message names 1 scoped variant price.

resources.name: attributeValueDelete — Gold (expect CANNOT_DELETE)
attributeDelete — Loyalty level test (expect CANNOT_DELETE)
attributeUpdate — removeValues Gold (expect CANNOT_DELETE)
variantChannelListingPriceCreate — no condition (expect REQUIRED)
variantChannelListingPriceCreate — plain text value (expect INVALID with customerAttributeValues)
variantChannelListingPriceCreate — validTo before validFrom (expect INVALID)
variantChannelListingPriceUpdate — clear every condition (expect REQUIRED)
resources.description: The price keeps both conditions.

resources.name: productVariant.pricing(customer:) — as customer (expect permission denied)
resources.description: The preview argument needs MANAGE_PRODUCTS and MANAGE_USERS. Expect a PermissionDenied error and null pricing.

resources.name: variantChannelListingPriceDelete — cleanup of the guard price
99 · Teardown
resources.description: Removes the test customers, the customer type and both attributes. Every scoped price and promotion of the collection must be gone first, otherwise the deletes are refused.

customerTypeDelete — B2B test
